open_questions: g_08206ccc: Scr_CompileFunctionBody writes a 4-byte word at 0x08206ccc, which overlaps the 4-byte symbol-table handle g_08206cc8 (bytes 4..7 of its range). Is this an intended second global or a binary-level aliasing quirk? The translation keeps the same two addresses.

Callee arity: 173 external placeholders are varargs. Several arities were recovered from stack stores, not from callee prototypes (for example fn_080ab65e receives g_08205c84*12 and fn_0807caac receives a two-word argument frame). The merge lane should confirm them.
Parse node and container layouts (cod2_scr_node size, cod2_scr_seq layout, pair items) are inferred from consistent offsets across 73 functions; no allocation site in this chunk fixes the node size.
Empty-list paths: Scr_CompileListStmt_3a dereferences the last cell and Scr_CompileLoop_Multi dereferences the list head item without a null check. Both are preserved as in the binary, not fixed.
Scr_CompileGuardedBlock calls Scr_CompileStmtList with a fifth stack word that the callee does not read. Translated with four arguments; the observable behaviour is identical.
Meaning of g_0839750b (dev/debug mode), Mem_BucketKey (priority key) and the symbol tables g_08205c88..94 is unknown; names are descriptive only.
